Le piccole masse renali (≤ 4 cm, T1a) so:
Small renal masses (≤ 4 cm, T1a) are often discovered incidentally. The first question is whether the lesion is solid (enhancement: signal increase after contrast, best measured or seen with subtraction) or cystic (Bosniak 2019). Clear cell carcinoma is usually hyperintense on T2 and enhances strongly in the arterial phase; it can have cystic and necrotic components even when small.
Treatment of T1a: partial nephrectomy as first choice; percutaneous ablation or active surveillance in elderly patients or those with comorbidities. Biopsy helps when it changes management.
In the report: location, size, exophytic/endophytic component, distance from the sinus and collecting system, relationship to the polar line (RENAL score).
